gates.title: Project binding receipt
gates.criterion: PROJECT_BINDING_RECEIPT.md names the canonical repository, branch, baseline commit, target artifact, stage, protocol-only limitation, and protected invariants.

gates.title: Runnable first screen
gates.criterion: A local static server serves the artifact; a real browser loads the single-screen game with title, Night 1 state, 9 lamp units, and no page errors.

gates.title: Three consequential nights
gates.criterion: Browser interaction makes exactly one allocation choice on each of three nights, each choice changes the consequence text and reduces lamp units, and Night 3 transitions to an ending.

gates.title: Choice-dependent ending
gates.criterion: Two deterministic browser playthroughs using different choices reach visibly different named endings and recorded decision histories.

gates.title: Rainy inn art direction
gates.criterion: Runtime screenshots clearly show rain, an inn, warm lamp light against cold night tones, and at least three visually distinguishable travelers without external assets.
